title: Comparing Uncertainty Measurement and Mitigation Methods for Large Language Models: A Systematic Review

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the misalignment between the model's predictive confidence (probability of generated tokens) and its actual accuracy using metrics such as Expected Calibration Error (ECE), SmoothECE, Brier Score, AUROC, and reliability diagrams.
Reviewing methods (e.g., PriDe) that address positional and selection biases in multiple-choice tasks by estimating prior bias over cyclic permutations of option tokens and positions.

Reviewing mitigation strategies for majority label, recency, and common token biases, such as Batch Calibration, which quantifies context bias from a batch and divides log probabilities by the average per-class prior.
